text: The best study app there is, especially for university / college studies ❤️ Simple to use, looks pretty, keeps everything organized and most importantly, saves time and energy because it's so quick and easy to list tasks and exams. I really appreciate the option to choose start and end dates for classes, none of the other study apps I've tried had this option.
